questions.question: In a certain code language, "JCPV" is coded as "51" and "DYSF" is coded as "48". What is the code for "HTOB" in that given language?
questions.solution:
The logic follows here, 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a6c1b703839665531bdb563757a69596253472c8767fec6930d8c04ec6c17a5.png] 

**For JCPV is coded as 51,**

 
• Sum of opposite positional values = 17 + 24 + 11 + 5 = 57
 
• Code = 57 − 6 = 51

 

**DYSF is coded as 48,**

 
• Sum of opposite positional values = 23 + 2 + 8 + 21 = 54
 
• Code = 54 − 6 = 48

 

**Similarly, let's find the code for HTOB:**

 
• Sum of opposite positional values = 19 + 7 + 12 + 25 = 63
 
• Code = 63 − 6 = 57

 

Hence, the correct answer is "option 4"

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the given statements.

Statements: Some butters are vegetables. All scales are vegetables.

Conclusions (I) Some butters are scales.

Conclusions (II) All vegetables are scales.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/79b08fbebaa604615d76be37de75b104ab5c2afe52fc262e3eb745be6d71a9ff.png] 

(I) Some butters are scales—Doesn't follow

(Their is no direct relation between butters and scales and some butters are scales; it may be possible but not definite. Hence, it is false) 

(II) All vegetables are scales—Doesn't follow

(All scales are vegetables but all vegetables are scale is may be possible but not definite. Hence, it is false)

**Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows. **

Hence, the correct answer is** "option 1".**

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.
(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

(5, 8, 14)
(19, 22, 28)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: Second Number = First Number + 3; Third Number = Second Number + 6**

For the first set **(5, 8, 14)**

⇒ 5 + 3 = 8

⇒ 8 + 6 = 14

For the second set **(19, 22, 28)**

⇒ 19 + 3 = 22

⇒ 22 + 6 = 28

Applying the same logic to the set in **Option 1**

**(34, 37, 43)**

⇒ 34 + 3 = 37

⇒ 37 + 6 = 43

Hence, the correct answer is **'Option 1'**.

= 41 × 16 + 271 − __611 ÷ 13__

= __41 × 16 __+ 271 − 47

= __656__ __+ 271__ − 47

= __927 − 47__

= 880

Hence, the correct answer is "**option 1"**
